item.title: Ryvorem Cat Window Perch Hammock – Foldable Suction Cup Seat – Khaki
item.description: Every cat wants the best seat in the house. Give yours a sunny window perch with a view, without giving up your sofa or your floor space. Why you'll like it Sunny window seat: a cozy hammock bed for naps, bird watching and people watching. No drilling, no tools: suction cups press onto clean, smooth glass. Space saving: it lives on the window, not on your floor. Folds flat: take it down for storage, cleaning or travel. Wipe-clean surface: a water-resistant cover that is easy to wipe down. Set up in 3 steps Clean the glass and the suction cups, then let both dry. Press each cup firmly onto smooth glass. Test the hold yourself before your cat climbs in. Use on clean, smooth glass only (not on textured, dirty or screened surfaces). Check the hold regularly and re-seat the cups if they loosen. What's included 1 cat window hammock (steel wire frame, fabric cover, suction cups). Available in 7 colors: Khaki, Off-White, Black, Gray, Lake Blue, Pink and Purple. Good to know How much weight can it hold? We don't publish a weight rating because the supplier information is not consistent enough to promise a number. It is meant as a nap spot for one cat at a time. Test the hold first and watch how your cat uses it, especially if your cat is large or you have more than one. Which windows does it fit? Clean, smooth glass. Check that your window has enough flat glass for the suction cups. Can I still use my blinds? You can fold the hammock flat and take it down when you need the window. How do I clean it? Wipe the cover with a damp cloth. Remove the hammock about once a month to clean the suction cups and the glass so they keep gripping.
